Preserve his facial proportions, face width, natural cheeks, eyes and their real asymmetry, brow shape, nose, lips, ears, natural skin tone, age and black cornrow braids pulled back. Realistic directional studio light with a real gentle shadow, skin pores, fine facial hair, realistic fabric, no airbrushed wax skin, no halos, no text, no watermark, no logos, no fake borders.
